title: High-Dwell Content
scenario: Find articles where the dwell time is 2 standard deviations above the category average.
tableSchema: articles (article_id INT, category_id INT), page_views (article_id INT, duration_seconds INT)
hint: Use AVG() OVER(PARTITION BY category_id) and STDDEV().
correctQuery: SELECT article_id FROM (SELECT article_id, duration_seconds, AVG(duration_seconds) OVER(PARTITION BY category_id) as avg_d, STDDEV(duration_seconds) OVER(PARTITION BY category_id) as std_d FROM articles JOIN page_views USING (article_id)) t WHERE duration_seconds > avg_d + 2 * std_d;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE articles (article_id INT, category_id INT); CREATE TABLE page_views (article_id INT, duration_seconds INT);
